capabilities: Sets per-line RTL/LTR direction ignoring math and Markdown syntax
Keeps formulas as LTR bidi islands
Shows live inline math preview while typing
disambiguation: Not a formula editor or math library; it only fixes bidirectional text direction and typing ergonomics for RTL languages mixed with LaTeX math.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.15.1 or later; tip to leave Obsidian's global RTL editor setting off. Install via BRAT beta or manually from the latest release.
problem: Obsidian's automatic bidi direction keys off the first character, so RTL text next to $...$ math flips to LTR, lines jump, and empty lines and Markdown syntax get the wrong direction.
summary: RTL support for LaTeX math in Obsidian: per-line direction, LTR formula islands, live inline preview, keyboard layout fix and LaTeX autocomplete.
